regime_context: The China A-shares detector shows Banks (score 0.998) as the outright leader with a durability bar of 0.73 and high breadth (0.889), but it is crowded (z=1.78). Innovative Pharma & CXO is a near-tie challenger (0.988, margin 0.01) also crowded. The absolute-trend gate did NOT help this market historically (gate_helps=false, backtest 'did_NOT_hold_here'), rotation breadth is narrow (4/22 eligible, one_narrative=false), and the track record shows only 37.7% directional accuracy over 77 calls — so conviction must be low and any lean treated as a falsifiable conditional, not an edge.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks-Pharma margin (currently 0.01) widens decisively with Banks remaining eligible AND Pharma's breadth expanding above 0.75 — if Banks lags CSI 300 for 10 straight sessions while Pharma holds its rank, the Banks leadership could be fading; if the margin widens with Banks' breath staying above 0.85, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks lead on rank and durability (0.73 bar, highest in the book) with broad participation (breadth 0.889). The crowded flag (z=1.78) is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade — the guardrails forbid fading the leader. Given gate_helps=false and the weak track record, this is at most a tentative expression that the dominant, durable theme persists over a short window, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: A mean-reverting tape in China A-shares whipsaws the trend gate (backtest shows it did NOT hold here), and the extremely narrow rotation breadth (0.18) plus high crowding on the leader suggests leadership could roll over quickly without a confirmed challenger.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) lags the CSI 300 by 5% and its 20-day momentum turns negative before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is essentially tied with Banks (score 0.988 vs 0.998, rotation margin only 0.01) and also eligible, but it is crowded as well (z=1.59) and has much weaker breadth (0.643) and a lower durability bar (0.60). It presents as a near-leader that could overtake Banks if Banks stalls, but this is a conditional read only — no confirmed handoff is signaled by the rotation block (directional=false).
theses.dissent: Breadth is narrow (0.643) and the theme is crowded; if this is a late-stage attention concentration it could mark a top, and the detector explicitly warns thematic inflows/attention spikes mark tops.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ (Pharma & CXO ETF) underperforms the CSI 300 by 5% and its breadth drops below 0.5 before the check-by date.
